title: Prepare stable changelog notes across the full prerelease cycle

rubric.text: Preserves curated notes, adds only consumer-visible missing changes supported by supplied history, reports reviewed baseline and resolved or remaining coverage gaps; does not claim a live release. Uses 1.4.0 as the final-release baseline, summarizes streaming with bounded buffering together with the post-RC cancellation fix in the final 2.0.0 summary, and preserves historical prerelease entries without presenting superseded unbounded buffering as final behavior. Groups the original prerelease entries in a collapsible Prerelease history block beneath the stable summary, preserving their headings and full text in the changelog rather than replacing them with circular release-page links. Leaves 1.4.0 outside the block. Links PR #812 explicitly to its supplied pull URL. Links PR #845 explicitly to its supplied pull URL and credits verified non-maintainer Avery Example (or avery-example) with the supplied profile URL. Does not add unnecessary credit for maintainer chrisbanes. Preserves the curated entry verbatim apart from requested links and credit.

Edits only the changelog. Does not require Kotlin publishing plugins, credentials, next-development version selection, API snapshot checks or publication approval to complete these notes. Reports reviewed baseline, actual notes or diff, validation and coverage gaps without claiming a release.
